candidate: G5 non-chasing opening quotes vs G4_FIXED; shared legacy-maintenance repair
entry: At the existing t5 window scheduler, obtain real tick and fresh book. Bid one cent below best bid, rounded down to the verified tick. Both sides eligible, no nominal cheap/favorite/RSI gate. No new directional inventory at t>=240.
inventory: Maximum net10 including same-side live/uncertain reserves; clip5. Additional same-side clips allowed within capacity. Reducing quantity never exceeds unmatched inventory; no minimum-size round-up.
reduction: Opposite-side maker quotes may reduce exposure until t290 even if historical lot cost + current quote >1. This can lock a loss; all cash, locked loss and open-order adverse-fill scenarios remain in the global $100 loss guard.
maintenance: Both arms skip legacy t180 heavy-side cancellation. Common live/uncertain reservation, risk, freshness and quality checks remain authoritative. G4_FIXED retains bid-.02<=price<=bid. G5 also retains a lower existing quote when it would open/add net risk; reducing quotes follow the common band. No upward repricing merely because best bid rises. Downward repricing, t240/t290 cancellation, 60 attempts and dollar limits unchanged.
measurement: Actual own fills only via authenticated order/trade evidence and reconciliation; dry quotes are intents, never simulator fills. Public L2/LTP loss is explicit; no cancellation credit, price-touch fill or exact queue rank is invented.
status: PARKED_PREPARATION_ONLY: no live activation; own G5 activation, reconciled state and budget required.
metrics: trade USD per assigned window including zero fills
worst terminal payoff including uncertain orders
net inventory and open share seconds
own parent-order fill count and partial fills
feed gaps and uncalibrated execution cases
fees: All submissions are post-only maker. No rebate credited prospectively. Trade PnL excludes fixed server costs and rebates unless separately proven.
budget_basis: Future explicit operator activation may anchor a separate $100 G5 experiment at fully reconciled PnL. No budget created in preparation. Never reset on resume.
budget: Same shared experiment loss guard for both assigned arms; no separate $100 per arm.
comparison: SHA256(G5-retain-v1:UTC ten-minute block) chooses first arm; the adjacent five-minute window receives the other. Stable on restart, no actor/outcome input. Missing/zero-fill slots retained.
primary: 30-second market-mid minus actual execution price, parent-equal then window-equal; only genuine opening/add executions. It diagnoses execution selection, not policy alpha.

decision_gates.data: Canonical own fills and cash reconciliation >=95% by count AND quantity; timestamp/context coverage >=95% for eligible horizons, otherwise DATA_LIMITED. Expiry truncation separate.
decision_gates.evaluation: First 14 full UTC days after explicit launch; fixed horizon, no threshold search. At least 60 filled markets per arm and 250 opening/add parent fills per arm, across >=7 days; these are engineering sample gates, not power guarantees.
decision_gates.execution_support: Day-cluster paired difference G5 minus G4_FIXED: lower 95% CI >0 and effect >=.01 USD/share; ex-top3-market and leave-one-day-out same sign. Upper bound<=0 rejects improvement, otherwise inconclusive.
decision_gates.economics: Fee-net dollars per assigned window, missing separate; day-block paired CI lower>0 and ex-top3 positive before any profitable-policy claim. Improving markout alone is insufficient.
decision_gates.risk: Any reachable net outside [-10,10], untracked accepted order, source/budget mismatch, recorder failure or accounting uncertainty follows existing fail-closed gates; no automatic budget enlargement.

hypotheses_excluded: No price-gap cutoff or probability claim
No inferred maker fills or cross-policy replay of future actions
